statements.t: The measure that matters from here is volume: we are reiterating our target of approximately $3 billion of Total Transacting Volume for 2026, setting a target of approximately $6 billion for the first half of 2027, and we will report what we deliver every month,” said Akshay Naheta, CEO of Bakkt.

Our full-year target implies approximately $2.4 billion of Total Transacting Volume in the fourth quarter, and we are reiterating it because the ramp has started: the institutional and cross-border clients driving it were integrating during the third quarter, activations began in October, and we expect them to increase significantly from November.

Monthly Active Users on our payment rails were 9,760 in September against a target of approximately 25,000 for December;4 Bakkt Agent’s Embedded Finance is available to partners today; and Strategic Asset Value in Bakkt Global reached $145.2 million.

The best of Bakkt is ahead of us, and we intend to show it month by month.” “Our third-quarter results reflect a lower operating cost base year over year and a balance sheet with no long-term debt,” said Matt White, CFO of Bakkt.

The Company is also building a cross-border trading desk to serve non-U.S. institutional clients, with an initial launch targeted for the fourth quarter of 2026, subject to banking, documentation and technology readiness and applicable approvals. ● Bakkt Payments Portal: The Bakkt Payments Portal is live for business clients, which can connect bank accounts and wallets, convert between cash and stablecoins, and…
The Company reiterates its target of approximately $3 billion of TTV for full-year 2026 and is establishing a target of approximately $6 billion of TTV for the first half of 2027.
MAUs were 9,760 for September 2026, the first period for which the measure is available, and the Company expects to report MAUs quarterly with its results.
